verdict.rationale: vLLM is an LLM inference and serving engine. It hosts models behind an API and has no product-side user data store where in-product AI insights would surface, so this story's axis does not fit the product type. Its tool calling, reasoning outputs and structured outputs are serving primitives that developers could use to build such features elsewhere. They are not an in-product insights capability and do not make the axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
